sources.entry: HedgeDoc - Realtime collaborative markdown notes on all platforms, formerly known as CodiMD and HackMD CE. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: HedgeDoc is a self-hostable real-time collaborative markdown note-taking app, formerly known as CodiMD and HackMD CE.
summary.what_it_does: HedgeDoc lets multiple people create and edit markdown notes together in real time. The README describes version 1.x as the stable, widely used release, with its codebase now in maintenance-only mode (no new features). HedgeDoc 2, a complete rewrite split into a backend and a frontend, is in development on the main branch and does not yet implement all features. A demo instance and an HedgeDoc 2 alpha demo are linked from the README. Installation instructions are referenced via an install guide on the project website rather than given in the README itself. The README does not detail specific editing features beyond real-time collaboration and markdown.
use_cases: real-time markdown editing with a team
notable: Successor project to CodiMD and HackMD CE
HedgeDoc 2 rewrite split into separate backend and frontend
Demo instance available for trying before installing
caveats: HedgeDoc 1.x is maintenance-only; new feature requests and PRs are not accepted for it
HedgeDoc 2 is in development and does not yet implement all features; its docs may change over time
Installation is described via external guide, not in the README
